---

The equinox that followed the death of Richard Jamerez was filled with celebration among the Pummelers that partook in it. Emmett, as promised, received the 250,000 ducketts and deposited half of it to the crew's shared account, and distributed the rest to Sanya, Garrick, Vargas, Valentina, and himself. Of course, before that, the crew had a hearty sleep. Sanya went to her room and planted herself, Valentina slept in the janitorial closet, given that she had not been given a room, and Vargas and Theylin crashed in the den. Garrick eavesdropped on Emmett, whose room was trashed from the emergence of The Crave. Emmett was smooshed against his wall as Jess was taking up all of the room on his small, twin-sized bed. The Squoatling, in particular, was shivering from the low temperature, and because of it, he was deeply snuggled into Jess's back. Garrick, despite his perspective on their awkward positioning, felt that Jess was in good hands—er, hooves. The ghost went to the thermostat and heated the ship up for him, making the place feel cozy and warm.

As soon as Emmett woke up, he immediately took his hooves off of Jess and sneezed from the immense amount of Ottori fur in his nose. He stealthily got out of his bed to make sure she did not wake, and he watched her for a little bit, acknowledging his crushed in closet door and the debris that needed to be cleaned up.

"[Damn, last night was a mess]{C38761d},"

Emmett muttered to himself, putting a hoof to his teeth. He realized that he definitely messed up his first impressions with the new Jess. It did not help that the other crew members locked the two of them in his room together, in the dark. Nor did it help that she immediately claimed his bed and slept. Still, however, he technically spooned her without asking, and he quickly clung to her like a tick. Emmett frowned a little. He felt guilty of his actions, especially of his Crave. Was what he did morally wrong? Was it illegal? Emmett pondered this in the quiet of the morning. Jess was of legal age to be an adult according to the Galactic Union, but she had the mental capacity of an independent twelve-year-old. She was adult-like in that manner, as she had to make do with whatever she found in Garrick's pockets. At least his conscience told him that he was not a pedophile. *Maybe I should apologize. Would that make things weirder? Or would it be the right thing to do?* Emmett took out his holodevice and searched on Delivoserv, the Universe's main source of delivery. If someone ordered a generic item, Delivoserv would deliver it within an hour without any regards to their reputation. They were a completely neutral and inviting company, and Emmett liked that about them.

"[What?]{C38761d}" Emmett was in disbelief. Supposedly his bed was going to have to wait. Delivoserv was being raided by pirates, and they updated their website with a countdown regarding when they would be able to deliver again. At least they were extremely prepared for this attack. Or they are just confident. Either way, his order was postponed. After he ordered the bed, Jess woke up, and she looked directly at him.

"[What happened?]{C666666}" She hugged her leg, wincing a bit in pain. "[All I remember is that you turned into a monster or something and you attacked me.]{C666666}" Emmett looked down and twisted his back hoof a bit, feeling genuine remorse. He could not lie to her, despite how much he wanted to.

"[I didn't mean to. I couldn't control it.]{C38761d}" Jess raised an eyebrow, confused.

"[So you didn't purposely start The Crave? Didn't you get it fixed?]{C666666}" Now Emmett was perplexed. How did she know about his tick? She just met him for the first time in four GUYs just the day before.

"[What? You know about The Crave?]{C38761d}" Jess realized her lack of context.

"[I know about The Crave. In fact, I know a lot about you.]{C666666}" Emmett tilted his head to the side and looked towards her. He did not know how to feel about this new information. "[You see, while inside of Garrick's pocket dimension, I didn't have much to do aside from search his stuff. He takes pretty much everything. However, he kept a special section organized and dedicated to you guys.]{C666666}"

"[Why would he do that?]{C38761d}" Jess shrugged.

"[I guess he cares about you guys or something. I don't know. There's a pile of stuff on Sanya, on Seth, et cetera. But he has a load of stuff on you.]{C666666}" Emmett shivered, realizing that Garrick took a lot of his stuff while he was away from the ship. He probably took pictures too. Pictures he didn't want to get in the wrong hands. He also realized that her tooth necklace was not made of shark teeth. Gross. "[It's funny. He wrote a lot of stuff a few GUYs back documenting you and your behavior. Maybe he was really interested in you. It was all in Universal Transcript, which I learned from a spare VIZO-TRAN.]{C666666}"

"[I really need to have a talk with him]{C38761d}," Emmett looked to his side and held his shaky arm, pretty embarrassed.

"[You're a pretty cool guy, actually. From what he wrote, you're like the craftiest and bestest pilot ever!]{C666666}" She giggled softly. Emmett felt like throwing up at this point.

"[What else do you know?]{C38761d}"

"[I know your race got blown up by the Llamanians. And that you've had a lot of intimate relations with them despite them wanting to kill you all of the time. Oh, and that Seth is like your dad.]{C666666}" She paused for a moment, trying to think of something. "[I'm sorry that I was so remote yesterday. I kinda didn't want to meet you as I didn't want my admiration of you to falter. I was also exhausted from attempting to expunge Garrick.]{C666666}" Jess definitely must have read a thesaurus or something.

"[Did it?]{C38761d}" Emmett ignored that last part of her trying to kill Garrick.

"[Well… I didn't know you were considered a criminal by the GU. Also, when Garrick wrote that you were a huge flirt, I definitely didn't think much about it at first. He was right though. You were a little creepy last night.]{C666666}" Emmett palmed his face as her statement made him hate himself.

"[I… I didn-]{C38761d}" Jess interrupted him quickly.

"[Don't apologize. I did technically steal your bed and I did hog up the space. Just don't whisper to me that stuff. We just met! Well, formally.]{C666666}"

"[I'm gonna leave. I feel ashamed.]{C38761d}" Jess popped up and grabbed his arm as he turned to exit.

"[If it makes you feel better, I kind-of liked it. It felt nice to feel someone's touch for the first time in so long. Just don't be like that again, or else it's going to get weird.]{C666666}"

"[Weird?]{C38761d}" Emmett stifled a chuckle, exhaling audibly.

"[Weird like that nude statue of you in Garrick's pocket. That's right. I know *everything* about you. Now get out of here. We'll talk more later.]{C666666}" Jess play-shooed him out of his own room. Emmett softly smiled, both confused and relieved at the same time. She then pushed him out after he didn't leave.

"[Let me dress, creep!]{C666666}" The hatch slammed behind him and he shrugged, venturing onward to the dining area.

Sanya and Garrick were hunched over the table in the dining room, seemingly whispering about something amongst themselves. The moment Emmett popped in, they practically jumped apart, with Garrick tending to a frying pan on a retro stove and Sanya shaving her fingers with a knife. Emmett did not notice anything out of the usual, and as such, he just stood in the doorway to the kitchen.

"[Hey guys. Good morning!]{C38761d}" He adjusted his translator as it felt a little tight and he sat at the table with Sanya.

"[You realize that you have no pants on, right, Emmett?]{C980000}", Sanya questioned, not taking her focus off of the knife. Emmett looked down at his boxer briefs and shrugged.

"[I got kicked out of my room. You realize you're cutting yourself, right?]{C38761d}" Garrick took the pan off of the stove and showed it to Emmett.

"[Food's ready, son.]{C1c4587}" Emmett saw nothing in the pan.

"[Food?]{C38761d}" Garrick shoved the pan in his face, making sure it did not touch him.

"[Yeah. Make your own food, Squemmy.]{C1c4587}" Emmett cringed at the nickname.

"[Please don't call me that. It makes me uncomfortable.]{C38761d}" Culturally, he did not want to be Garrick's mate. Nor in any way, for that matter. Garrick went into the fridge and grabbed an assortment of vegetables, particularly ones that were leaflike. He cut them all up and put them in a bowl, giving it to Emmett.

"[I was just kidding. Sheesh.]{C1c4587}" Emmett nodded and divulged in his salad. Sanya eyeballed him, feeling a bit of disgust.

"[You know, you're a freak for eating my brethren.]{C980000}" Sanya, of course, was saying this sarcastically. She did not approve of Emmett's generally vegetarian diet. Emmett tried saying something with a full mouth. Despite his apparent full cheeks and muffled voice, he still seemed a bit charming. Sanya rolled her eyes regardless. "[Gross.]{C980000}"

"[Emmett, your mom and I were think-]{C1c4587}"

"[Garrick, can you please stop with the parent schtick? It's really pissing me off.]{C980000}" Sanya looked livid, at least for a few seconds. Garrick glanced over at Emmett as he swallowed.

"[It's kind-of uncomforting to me too. Mostly thinking of you guys as a married couple.]{C38761d}"

"[I just kind-of assumed that because Jess is technically my child now, and that you're protecting her and sleeping in her room… Nevermind. Sanya and I were thinking of taking you on a boating trip. We have a lot of money combined, and we think giving us a break will help you out with your grass problem.]{C1c4587}" Emmett folded his arms.

"[I don't have a grass problem. I need it to survive. Squoat even told me that.]{C38761d}" He then coughed strongly, causing him to pound on his chest. Sanya got up and took to Emmett's side, ready to get whatever might have been choking him out of his system. "[I'm fine, I'm fine. Just feeling a bit run down. What's new?]{C38761d}"

"[You say you don't have a grass problem and then you decide to show us your grass problem. Funny.]{C980000}"

"[Sanya, quit being a dick. I can't help coughing.]{C38761d}" Sanya put down her knife on the table.

"[Am I being a dick? I can't tell. I've just been in the dumps and my back aches from sleeping in a pot.]{C980000}" Garrick looked confused.

"[Why are you sleeping in a pot again?]{C1c4587}"

"[I don't know. I wanted to try it. I read on the Hypernet that some florans really enjoy a potted treatment. I hate it.]{C980000}" Emmett finished his food up and put it in the sink.

"[I'll go with you guys. I haven't been boating since I was… ten GUYs old? We had a few canals that my parents owned back on Vortox.]{C38761d}" Emmett frowned a little.

"[Of course they don't exist anymore because Vortox exploded]{C1c4587}," Garrick butted in. Emmett glared at the ghost.

"[Thanks. I *really* forgot about my home planet exploding.]{C38761d}" Garrick shrugged. "[Any place in particular? Or do you want to keep it a secret?]{C38761d}" Sanya put a roughly shaven plant finger to her chin.

"[It'll stay a secret. You can go sleep in with Jess if you want. We'll get the autopilot rolling.]{C980000}" Sanya smirked a little, having seen the two of them in bed earlier.

"[That's not cool dude. I told you to protect her, not to corrupt her]{C1c4587}," Garrick mused, obviously trying to get under Emmett's skin. The Squoatling left towards the den.

"[Yeah, screw you guys too.]{C38761d}" Sanya and Garrick snickered in unison. The two of them made their way to the cockpit and input the coordinates.

"[Are you sure this is the place?]{Cbf9000}" Volentina asked this, having been in the captain's seat. She liked the idea of having power, and she eventually was going to get her foot in the door in terms of achieving it. The bear only needed to establish a few connections, and pranking Emmett with Sanya and Garrick was one of them.

"[This is it. We just needed to keep Emmett from getting in here. He took our bait and is pretty pissed at the moment]{C980000}," Sanya responded, sitting in Emmett's plush pilot's chair. "[I think I know why he loves being here now. This seat is amazing.]{C980000}"

"[Yeah, but you have to go through Seth's room to even get in here. Kinda lame.]{C1c4587}" Garrick propped himself atop of the command center, making sure his bottom half did not touch any buttons. Volentina snickered softly.

"[We should definitely take a picture of him when he finally realizes what's going on. He'll be ballistic!]{Cbf9000}"
